messages:
claire-fin: Heads up — batch invoice run for 03/18 showed a merged line problem for customer Nimbus. Compute line is missing and there's a phantom -$1,250 credit. Can someone check the job logs?

matt-eng: looking now. I see the billing job and the proration job overlapped for that account. Possibly a race during invoice line aggregation.

raj-billing: omg. that could explain the negative credit. which job id?

matt-eng: job ids: 
```
billing-20260318-4721
proration-20260318-4720
```
Those ran within ~30s of each other. aggregation service isn't fully idempotent for partial writes.

elaine-ops: @matt-eng can you roll forward a fix? we need a hotpatch because customer already flagged a support ticket.

matt-eng: I can add a transactional lock on invoice aggregation to prevent concurrent merges. quick patch ready, will deploy to staging.

claire-fin: we should also correct the affected invoices before EOD. Raj, can finance issue an adjustment for Nimbus and set them to manual review for the next 48h?

raj-billing: yes — I'll create an adjustment draft and put the account into manual gating. also adding regression test: ensure billing+proration overlap doesn't double-apply credits.

billing-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-342 — billing aggregation race condition. Assigned to matt-eng. SLA: P2.

matt-eng: deployed lock to staging, running a replay of the 03/18 jobs against a sandbox DB. results look good — no duplicate/phantom lines when run concurrently.

elaine-ops: schedule a production deploy and a small backfill reconciliation job to regenerate invoices for any accounts that saw overlapping jobs. keep it low priority for non-enterprise customers.

claire-fin: thanks. Raj, once adjustments created, DM me the invoice ids so we can notify the affected customers and finalize refunds if needed.

raj-billing: will do. creating adjustments now. ETA 90m.

matt-eng: will open a PR for the lock + add e2e for concurrency. linking here when ready.
